features.name: ai_use_code_band
features.description: Coarse ordinal band for the encoded AI-use taxonomy: 0 unknown, 1 codes 0-2, 2 codes 3-5, 3 codes 6 and above.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stable low-cardinality split over the AI-use taxonomy without requiring many narrow code splits.

features.name: deployment_evidence_balance
features.description: Difference between real-world deployment and evidence-strength scores.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives trees a direct thresholdable measure of deployment emphasis relative to formal validation.

features.name: deployment_ahead_of_evidence_flag
features.description: Indicator for high deployment emphasis paired with modest evidence strength.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a nonlinear pattern that would otherwise require multiple nested splits.

features.name: protocol_rigor_count
features.description: Count of protocol maturity and rigor indicators: randomization, blinding, later phase, larger enrollment bucket, and stronger evidence score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses several design-quality fields into an ordinal count that supports simple tree splits.

features.name: early_small_open_design_flag
features.description: Indicator for known early-phase, small-enrollment, non-blinded study designs.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a direct split for low-scale open designs, a useful interaction among phase, enrollment, and blinding.

features.name: ai_specificity_term_count
features.description: Count of explicit technical AI terms present in the row: AI, algorithm, machine learning, and deep learning.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns sparse mention flags into an ordinal specificity signal that trees can split on directly.

features.name: digital_delivery_term_count
features.description: Count of implementation-channel terms present in the row: software, mobile app, and wearable.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes product-like delivery channels in a compact count suited to threshold splits.

features.name: governance_topic_count
features.description: Count of governance-related topics present in the row: bias, safety, and privacy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates sparse governance mentions into a simple ordinal feature for direct splitting.

features.name: geographic_reach_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal geographic reach: 0 none or unknown, 1 single-country, 2 multi-country or explicitly international.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an interpretable scale feature that combines country count and international-trial flag.

features.name: trial_progress_ordinal
features.description: Status precedence code: 0 other or unknown, 1 recruiting, 2 completed.
features.expected_model_benefit: Collapses status indicators into a single ordered feature for concise progress-related splits.

features.name: workflow_embedding_judgment
features.description: Ordinal expert assessment from row metadata: 0 offline analytic use, 1 decision-support or algorithm evaluation, 2 participant- or clinician-facing digital delivery, 3 embedded real-world workflow or device-like deployment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact semantic view of how deeply the AI system is embedded in practice, reducing reliance on several separate splits.

features.name: translation_readiness_judgment
features.description: Ordinal expert assessment from row metadata: 0 exploratory concept, 1 early feasibility, 2 structured prospective evaluation, 3 mature large or multicenter evaluation, 4 near-operational product or service readiness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes scale, evidence, deployment, and operational maturity into an interpretable ordinal feature for tree thresholds.
